description: This file defines functions and types for handling reactions in the BlueBubbles messaging platform, including reaction normalization, aliasing, and sending reactions via API calls.

methods.name: resolveAccount
methods.description: Resolves account details using provided options.

methods.name: normalizeBlueBubblesReactionInput
methods.description: Normalizes reaction input (emoji or alias) to a standard reaction string.

methods.name: sendBlueBubblesReaction
methods.description: Sends a reaction to a message via BlueBubbles API.
